header.title: Long nominal assets and commodities on strong nominal growth and high inflation

s01_bottom_line.text: The speaker argues nominal assets are big-picture where you want to be given strong GDP growth and high inflation, unless a disinflationary bust occurs, now favoring a more barbell portfolio.
Stay long nominal assets over the medium and long term but add a barbell for protection against a disinflationary bust.
The nominal-asset/commodity trade has been repriced alongside AI de-risking; the view is that this may be overdone but hinges on whether AI capex sustains.

items.text: Nominal assets are the preferred position big-picture, unless there is a disinflationary bust (capex slows, retrenchment, a proper credit cycle).
The economy has shifted from a savings glut to a spending glut, a seismic change raising the cost of capital.
The de-risking has been indiscriminate, throwing the baby out with the bathwater across nominal assets and commodities.
GDP growth is still very strong and inflation is high, supporting a long-nominal-assets stance.
The speaker suggests a more barbell portfolio is now more sensible while still favoring nominal assets medium/long term.
